tools.name: pricing

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "onchain" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_data, spot_price, ens_resolve · Private data: find_data, request_data, token_safety, ens_resolve, chain_info, nft_scam_check · Public sink: find_data, gas_compare, ens_resolve, chain_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_data, spot_price, ens_resolve · Private data: find_data, request_data, token_safety, ens_resolve, chain_info, nft_scam_check · Public sink: find_data, gas_compare, ens_resolve, chain_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
